title: SLEEP & MELATONIN
hook: melatonin|it is a clock, not a sedative
style: cinematic film still, anamorphic, dramatic contrast, moody practical lighting, rich shadows, filmic grain, high detail

music.tags: late night jazz, muted trumpet, brushed drums, upright bass, rhodes piano, smoky lonely, instrumental

beats.prompt: A dark bedroom with a single bedside lamp on, warm pool of light, night outside the window, calm
beats.motion: The lamp glows steadily. Shadows shift very slightly.
beats.caption: A timing signal, not a sedative

line.text: Melatonin is a timing signal, not a sedative. It tells your body it is night.

beats.sfx: a quiet bedroom at night, faint hum

beats.prompt: A city window at night with blue screen light spilling into a dark room, moody, cinematic
beats.caption: Late bright light delays the signal

line.text: Bright light late in the evening delays that signal. Which is why the phone is part of the problem.

beats.prompt: An airport departure board at night, out of focus, cool light, travel mood, cinematic
beats.caption: Clearest use: moving the clock

line.text: The clearest use in the research is jet lag and shifted schedules - moving the clock, not forcing sleep.

beats.prompt: A dark quiet bedroom with the first grey light at the curtains, calm, cinematic, no people
beats.motion: The light at the curtain slowly brightens.
beats.caption: The dull advice still wins

line.text: For ordinary bad sleep, the dull advice still beats the bottle: same wake time, dark room, less light at night.

beats.prompt: An empty made bed in soft morning light, calm and quiet, minimal
beats.caption: Not medical advice

line.text: General information, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about what fits you.
